# Independent review of root contract 01

No blocking semantic inconsistency was found in the frozen root-authored
ordinary before-code contract. Its SHA-256 is
`60d3508a0bff407cc9acd8d66baa141fab9ce093d23ec8e57cfc13ee54b835e1`.
This is a read-only preparation review, not implementation approval, a human
constitutional act, a proof or Issue completion. I did not author this root
contract. I did author the older non-normative candidate/dataflow notes it cites;
those notes were treated as historical inputs rather than independently endorsed
evidence. The existing two guarantees and pending QS/PR/RS/EXACT duties are
unchanged. Constitutional startup and the trusted-base continuity guard were
completed earlier in this same context, before dependent work.

The literal catalogs contain 17 finite and 18 selected names, with eight common
names and exactly 27 distinct fully qualified names. The contract preserves
Toffoli's `((Q<Bit>,Q<Bit>),Q<Bit>)` result, exact binary split/join tree,
T/S/inverse powers versus whole scalar omega, Observe/init0 effects, ordered
register extraction/insertion, explicit zero-owner empty/consume, ordinary
classical bit packaging, and Unit/unit/finish arity, owner transitions and +1
coefficient. Packaged scalar source support is explicitly a migration; selected
atom-only realization remains an eligibility restriction. Catalog membership
cannot manufacture emitter/native support. All four real registry modules,
including private `nonzero2`, qif(id,s/t), Toffoli, computed reflection and the
retained meter, are accounted for without granting their names privilege.

The policy migrations match actual code/spec differences: unused import-only
cycles become allowed, public/private self-imports collide, final-token import
locations replace selected whole-use locations, active static binders cannot be
runtime-shadowed, and packaged scalar source typing is unified. Actual dependency
cycles remain errors and only the existing discharged decreasing runtime
self-call can be excepted. These are explicit ordinary migration choices, not
new constitutional interpretations. Update Reference/tests as the contract
requires; do not rewrite historical diagnostics.

## Required implementation checkpoints

- Put the complete shared judgment before both adapter eligibility and native
  selection/emission. The finite entry currently constructs `Kernel::selected`
  before `profile::check`, and selected parsing currently performs a per-module
  `parser::project` before reading the next module. Leaving either route there
  would preserve an earlier refusal that hides source errors. Use small missing
  kernel + invalid private body, earlier semantic + later unsupported body, and
  later malformed-module controls to classify the new order honestly.
- Budget construction itself. `Resolution::new`, `Index::new`, table/global
  binding, Type tree construction and `Context::push` copies currently allocate
  or clone before the proposed shared work cap. Pass a fallible budget or
  preflight exact bounded cardinality before each construction; charging an
  already built index/context does not meet this contract. Preserve separate
  concrete budgets and selected retained-scope capacity.
- Retain original lexical identity with a viable lifetime. `Index<'ast>` may
  borrow each immovable original Decl throughout shared checking, with owned
  numeric facts carried into adapters after dropping the address map. A
  collection-owned Forest is also viable, but current `Forest::insert` drops
  `Index.natural_references`; extend it before using original Nat occurrences.
  Reindex moved/cloned syntax rather than carrying its old address map. Public
  mutable Project operations must recreate facts from supplied originals.
- Preserve complete lookup when projection is deferred. Current selected
  `definition`/instantiation/elaboration consume `Vec<Function>` by original
  `ast_index`; Basis/Meaning/qif/refined forms cannot simply be filtered out.
  Migrate generic consumers to original Decl plus checked interfaces, and retain
  any temporary projected result or located eligibility failure by DefId with
  full cardinality/association. The shared result must contain consumed typed
  facts/obligations, not a pass bit beside old source checker loops.
- Keep edge kind and discharge state. `resolve::cycle(..., allow_self=true)`
  alone would waive every self-edge. Distinguish actual runtime calls with the
  proved existing Nat decrease from static provider, Meaning and Basis edges;
  preserve original closing-edge spans and every private/dead/zero-body edge.
  Infer BodyEffects only after this graph checks; annotations must not seed it.
- Migrate actual symbolic judgments rather than projecting a new canonical AST.
  Existing symbolic natural/solver entry points take the selected projected
  syntax; adapt them to original Natural/Predicate and original Index identities
  while reusing linear algebra and exact staged error order. Ordinary Basis
  calls retain declared arity and totality; Meaning phase results retain the
  exact `(Bit,(Bit,Bit))` tree. Computed/coherent rules retain predicate arity,
  protected/captured owners and located later cleanup/injectivity/equality
  obligations. No successful generic type fact is a clean-release proof.

The 1,000,000 common-work migration, selected 64-module count including four
bundles, loader preallocation checks, parser-before-semantics ordering, and
source/eligibility/evidence/native diagnostic separation are sufficiently
explicit for a concrete ordinary implementation record. No new source,
primitive rule, compatibility exception or acceptance widening was chosen in
this review. The contract still requires independent review of actual code and
current/MSRV validation; none is supplied here.

## First evidence and limits

All FIRST41 original hashes/bytes/modes and the preserved first-packet file map
were read and rechecked. Each of the 72 event statuses and raw stdout/stderr/
journal hashes was compared with stored data; the totals are 18 success,
54 refusal and 304 pre-execv forwarding rows. Every text/JSON pair retains its
same first status. Those rows do not independently attest native starts/exits.
The real earlier unsupported Nat/Basis/qif/missing-bundle gates were preserved
and are not evidence that a later semantic rule was checked. The selected
first entry didn't contain the four automatic bundles; the proposed count of
64 including four is therefore an intentional new loading policy.

No stored command, driver, test, CLI/native process, Cargo/Lean build, Git or
GitHub operation was run. Only metadata/source reads, hashing and the new
review directory were performed. No original contract/source/first record was
changed. This review does not establish source preservation, concrete provider
correspondence, full common emitter support, canonical QFT exposure or any
#32/#317 completion credit.
